motivation: E2B copies the JSON escape of the harness's file view into its edits; output-side writes are capped by Gemma 4's norms (EXP-096), so this edit removes the escape feature from what the attention heads read, as an exact rank-1 v_proj LoRA.
hypothesis: Escape-blind values raise the share of applying bench answers on held-out states against the unedited model in the same server (exact McNemar p < 0.05) and against a random-direction control, with no fewer correct answers and no significant MBPP+ loss.

config.control: random unit direction per layer, seed 97, same layers and alpha
